blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Seafood certified to MSC's environmental standard for fishing.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Adults take 1 softgel 1 - 2 times daily with food, or as recommended by a qualified healthcare professional.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Softgel capsule (fish gelatin [tilapia- sourced], vegetable glycerin, purified water), tocopherols.
Fish oil sourced from Alaska. Proudly manufactured in the USA with carefully selected ingredients of domestic and international origins.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children and pets. Consult with a qualified healthcare professional prior to using this product, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, have a diagnosed medical condition, are taking a prescription medication (e.g ., blood thinners), or are planning a surgical procedure. Do not exceed recommended daily intake. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. Store at room temperature, in a dry place. Protect product from excessive heat, freezing, humidity and light.
Note: Omega-3 Fish Oil in Triglyceride Form (TG as rTG).
